frequentlyAsked.title: Your Questions Answered
frequentlyAsked.description: Everything you need to know before downloading

q1.content: 100% free, forever. No trial period that expires, no "premium" upsells, no limits. Download as many videos as you want, whenever you want.

q2.trigger: Why don't you require an account?
q2.content: Because we believe downloading should be instant. No forms, no passwords, no verification emails—just paste and download.

q3.content: Yes, for personal use. Always respect creators' rights—don't repost content without permission or use videos commercially without authorization.

q4.trigger: Do you store my downloads or data?
q4.content: Never. We don't store videos, track your downloads, or collect personal information. Your privacy is guaranteed.

q1.trigger: What types of Instagram content can I download?
q1.content: Instagram posts, reels, IGTV videos, and carousel videos. We support all public Instagram video content.

q2.content: Our service only works with public Instagram content. Private account videos cannot be downloaded.

q3.content: We fetch the highest quality available—typically the same resolution the creator uploaded. Most videos are 720p-1080p HD.

q4.trigger: What video format do you provide?
q4.content: Videos download as MP4 files, compatible with all devices and video players.

q5.trigger: Does it work on mobile devices?
q5.content: Absolutely! Our downloader works perfectly on iPhone, Android, tablets, and all mobile browsers.
